image_description: A blue, four-wheeled golf cart parked on a paved surface with a beige brick wall in the background. The cart features a cream-colored hardtop roof, a clear windshield, black tubular frame supports, and custom white graphics/decals on the side panels. It has two forward-facing seats with headrests and a rear cargo rack.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the standard compact proportions of a golf cart, fitting the expected silhouette.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows an open-sided body structure topped with a solid, cream-colored hardtop roof supported by pillars.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Two distinct seat cushions are visible side-by-side, indicating a bench-style seating arrangement for at least two passengers.

artifact_observations.location: Side panel decals and front bumper area
artifact_observations.reasoning: The white graphics on the side of the cart resemble text or logos but are illegible and structurally nonsensical upon close inspection, a common AI artifact where text-like shapes are generated without semantic meaning.

The transparency of the windshield is inconsistent; it reflects the background slightly but lacks the sharp specular highlights expected of glass/plastic, appearing somewhat 'smudged' or semi-opaque in areas.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific sub-type of the vehicle and ensure it aligns with the 'golfcart' ImageNet class rather than a generic car or buggy.
To verify the structural integrity of the tubular frame and ensure the transparent windshield does not cause depth bleeding with the background wall.
To check for fusion artifacts where the tires meet the pavement and where the roof pillars connect to the body/frame.
To rigorously analyze the illegible white markings on the side to determine if they are failed attempts at rendering specific brand text or logos.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of side decals/logos
Transparency and reflection properties of the windshield
Connection points of the roof frame to the chassis
Tire contact patches with the ground
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact on the side panels. While the overall geometry is strong, AI models often fail at rendering coherent text/logos on vehicles. Verify if the 'illegible' nature is due to image resolution or actual generative failure. Also, scrutinize the windshield for any 'melting' into the background wall.
